scope: One actual OpenAI-hosted session with one cancellation follow-up, normal five-object contract in isolated workerd, remote ID/checkpoint artifacts before consuming later events.
revalidation: New Work and fresh invocation after bounded read-only waiting repair; the previous mission is never resent and its immutable dispatch claim remains.
diagnostic_attempt: Retain only the documented failure category before cleanup; terminal failure is recorded once without repeated read attempts. Previous sessions must still return404. No automatic retry or resend of earlier Work.
